subject.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer

question: Should usage-enabled reply footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup during reply delivery, or should quota text wait for cached or preloaded provider usage state?
rationale: The implementation is focused and well aligned with the existing provider-usage seam, but choosing to add provider/auth probing to final reply delivery is a latency and product-behavior tradeoff automation should not decide.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Land this design after the docs repair if maintainers accept the 2500 ms cap and omit-on-failure behavior for usage-enabled replies.

options.title: Require Cached State
options.body: Ask for the footer to read warmed or cached quota snapshots instead of probing provider usage during final reply delivery.

options.title: Keep Status Only
options.body: Reject inline provider quota footers and keep `/status` plus CLI status surfaces as the supported quota-window display.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Land this design after the docs repair if maintainers accept the 2500 ms cap and omit-on-failure behavior for usage-enabled replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history match for the provider-usage/status seam and the latency/auth tradeoff this PR extends into reply delivery.
